【内容提要】上集《赤壁大战》，叙孙权联合刘备，用火攻大破曹兵。
本集叙周瑜乘胜进攻南郡，与守将曹仁相持不下。诸葛亮乘孙、曹两军兵力疲乏的机会，遣赵云袭取南郡，又用南郡的兵符，调开荆州、襄阳的曹军；不费一兵一卒，得了三处城池。周瑜劳而无功，一气成病。
下集《战长沙》，叙关羽奉令攻取长沙，收降老将黄忠
（本书根据罗贯中《三国演义》改编）

（1）曹操从华容道逃奔下来，只剩下二十七骑了。将到南郡，天色已晚。忽然前面火把齐明，有队兵马拦住去路。曹操大惊失色，抖索着说：“我的性命完了！”
page_text_en:
【Content Summary】The previous chapter, "The Battle of Red Cliffs," narrates how Sun Quan allied with Liu Bei and used fire attacks to defeat Cao Cao's army.
This chapter narrates Zhou Yu's advance to attack Nan Commandery, where he was held at a stalemate by the defending general Cao Ren. Zhuge Liang took advantage of the exhausted forces of Sun and Cao to send Zhao Yun to capture Nan Commandery, then used Nan Commandery's military token to disperse Cao Cao's troops in Jingzhou and Xiangyang; without losing a single soldier, he gained three cities. Zhou Yu, having worked hard but achieved nothing, fell ill from frustration.
The next chapter, "The Battle of Changsha," narrates Guan Yu's mission to capture Changsha and recruit the veteran general Huang Zhong.
(This book is adapted from Luo Guanzhong's "Romance of the Three Kingdoms")

(1) Cao Cao fled down the Huarong Road, with only twenty-seven riders left. As he approached Nan Commandery, it was already dark. Suddenly, torches lit up ahead, and a troop of soldiers blocked his path. Cao Cao was terrified and trembled, saying, "My life is over!"
summary_zh: 本页上半部分为内容提要，概述了上集《赤壁大战》、本集《取南郡》及下集《战长沙》的情节，并注明改编自《三国演义》；下半部分为第一幅插图及文字，描绘曹操从华容道逃至南郡时，被敌军火把围困，惊恐万分，自认性命难保。

summary_zh: 曹操在南郡安歇时，因想起已故谋士郭嘉而痛哭，感叹若郭嘉在世，必不会遭遇此等大败，众谋士听后羞愧难当。
